fusions.name: Bolting Strike
fusions.desc: You bolt at the target first, then strike for 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Hind Thump
fusions.desc: A hind-foot thump that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Overrun
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Breather
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs empty, you restore 3 stamina a second for 4 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
